releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.37 - Standalone On-Device Vision Engine & Cyber-Glassmorphic UI Redesign
releaseNotes:
* Cyber-Glassmorphic UI Redesign: Completely redesigned app interface based on Google Stitch design system with concentric AI radar vision scanner, glowing batch arc progress dial, and live AI perception telemetry cards
* Standalone On-Device Vision Engine: 100% untethered screen vision using on-device ML Kit OCR & shape detection directly in the Android app with zero PC/laptop connection required
* 100% Ad Skipping Success Rate: Eliminates blind probing completely; only clicks visually confirmed close buttons or issues safe back-press at 28s timeout, completely preventing accidental Play Store/Chrome opens
* Autonomous Celebration Continuation: Accurately identifies Pocket FM's 'Episodes ... Unlocked' celebration dialog and auto-clicks 'Unlock 2 more Episodes' / ads_view to progress continuously without manual intervention
* Smart Battery Efficiency (<3-5%/hr): Throttles frame captures and sleeps during the initial 20s of video ad playback; runs fast-path 600ms scans only during active skip/end-card windows
* Automatic Session Start on Pocket FM: Automatically detects Pocket FM in the foreground and activates automation without requiring manual navigation
